```{r}

library(stringr)
sheets <- c("foxp2","opn","satb1","satb2","tbr1","tusc5","brnc3")

# helper to evaluate the predicted_normalized formula from the first row
get_predicted_value <- function(df) {
  
  pred_formula <- df[[8]][1]   # predicted_normalized column (H)
  predicted_col <- df[[7]][1]  # predicted column (G)
  lookup_vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[10]]))  # column J values
  
  # if predicted column is 0, return 0
  if (!is.na(predicted_col) && suppressWarnings(as.numeric(predicted_col)) == 0) {
    return(0)
  }
  
  # if already numeric, use it
  if (!is.na(pred_formula) && is.numeric(pred_formula)) {
    return(pred_formula)
  }
  
  # if blank, return 0
  if (is.na(pred_formula) || pred_formula == "") {
    return(0)
  }
  
  pred_formula <- as.character(pred_formula)
  pred_formula <- gsub("^=", "", pred_formula)
  pred_formula <- gsub("\\$", "", pred_formula)
  
  # handle SUM(J4:J7)
  if (grepl("^SUM\\(", pred_formula)) {
    inside <- str_match(pred_formula, "SUM\\((J\\d+):(J\\d+)\\)")
    start_row <- as.numeric(sub("J", "", inside[2]))
    end_row   <- as.numeric(sub("J", "", inside[3]))
    return(sum(lookup_vals[start_row:end_row], na.rm = TRUE))
  }
  
  # handle formulas like J2+J5+J6+J7
  refs <- unlist(str_extract_all(pred_formula, "J\\d+"))
  if (length(refs) > 0) {
    rows <- as.numeric(sub("J", "", refs))
    return(sum(lookup_vals[rows], na.rm = TRUE))
  }
  
  return(NA_real_)
}

animal_means <- map_df(sheets, function(s) {
  
  df <- read_excel(file, sheet = s, col_names = TRUE, .name_repair = "unique")
  
  # keep only real image rows
  df_images <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(id), !is.na(replica))
  
  # 5th column is the marker-specific coloc count
  coloc_col <- names(df_images)[5]
  
  # calculate actual percentage directly from counts
  df_images <- df_images %>%
    mutate(
      actual_percentage = (.data[[coloc_col]] / tdt) * 100
    )
  
  # average replicas within animal
  animal_df <- df_images %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    summarise(
      actual = mean(actual_percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      marker = s,
      predicted = get_predicted_value(df)
    )
  
  animal_df
})

animal_means$marker <- factor(
  animal_means$marker,
  levels = c("opn", "brnc3", "foxp2", "tbr1", "satb1", "satb2", "tusc5")
)

# n should now be number of animals
n_counts <- animal_means %>%
  group_by(marker) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(id), .groups = "drop")

print(n_counts)
print(animal_means %>% filter(marker == "opn"))

# make long format
data_long <- animal_means %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(actual, predicted),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    type = recode(type,
      actual = "Actual",
      predicted = "Predicted"
    )
  )

colocalization <- ggplot(data_long, aes(x = marker, y = value, fill = type)) +
  
  geom_bar(
    stat = "summary",
    fun = "mean",
    color = "black",
    width = 0.7,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  ) +
  
  geom_errorbar(
    data = subset(data_long, type == "Actual"),
    stat = "summary",
    fun.data = mean_se,
    width = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  ) +
  
  geom_point(
    data = subset(data_long, type == "Actual"),
    aes(fill = type),
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.08,
      dodge.width = 0.8
    ),
    size = 3,
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  
  geom_text(
    data = n_counts,
    aes(x = marker, y = 95, label = paste0("n=", n)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Actual" = "grey40", "Predicted" = "white")
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Marker",
    y = "% colocalization",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.margin = margin(t = 30, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 16, angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1.5),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )

colocalization

ggsave("colocalization_plot.pdf", plot = colocalization, width = 7, height = 5)
```
